reference.note: probable: 'PROPOSAL FOR COMMERCIAL BUILDING - Construction of 3 storey data centre facility, warehouse and offices. Construction of a link bridge to buildings 4 and 5, onsite power generators, landscaping and associated works' at 5 Tralee St (Block 103 Sec 7 Hume). It is the only CDC data-centre building DA on Block 103 after HU4, and its timing matches CDC's 'HU5 under construction' in 2021 (source 8); HU6 is a separate two-storey building on Block 99 (DA 202443633). The phrase 'link bridge to buildings 4 and 5' does not fit a building that is itself HU5, so CDC's internal building numbering may differ - not confirmed. Related: DA 202038049 (amendment to a three-storey warehouse/office approval incl. chiller deck and lease variation raising allowable GFA to 31,550 sqm, lodged 2021-01-22, approved 2021-04-08, source 7)
